Meet Brie

Your partner in building it the right way.

I'm Brie, founder of Brie's Small Business Solutions. I've watched too many good businesses struggle because they skipped the foundations: formation, compliance, banking, technology and systems.

So I help entrepreneurs get those right from day one, then give them the tools to grow, including an AI assistant that keeps the phone answered and the calendar full.

"Your business deserves to be done right the first time."Brie, Founder

Questions

Good to know.

Something else on your mind? Call (504) 475-2631.

Do you work with businesses outside New Orleans?

Yes. I'm based in New Orleans and work with clients remotely across the U.S.

Will the AI assistant sound like a robot?

No. It speaks in a calm, natural voice, knows your services and reads back names and numbers to get them right. Try the chat assistant on this page to see for yourself.

Do I need a new phone number?

Not necessarily. You can get a new business number, or forward your current number to the assistant when you're busy or after hours.

What if I already have an LLC?

We'll review what's in place, fix any gaps, then move on to your website, systems and growth.

How do I get started?

Request a consultation below or call (504) 475-2631. We'll talk through your goals and map out next steps together.
